name: Paw It Forward Pet Pantry
neighborhoods: Valley Stream, Long Island (Nassau) - outside NYC
region_note: PET FOOD PANTRY (Valley Stream, Nassau County)
notes: A volunteer pet food pantry: short-term supplies of cat food, cat litter and dog food, dry and canned, for owners who are struggling to feed their pets. Food is picked up in Valley Stream; email volunteerpawitforward@gmail.com to arrange it. Runs as a Facebook group, Paw It Forward Pet Pantry (created 2018). Read on that group by a reviewer, 2026-11-05. Its drop-off point is a private address, so it is not published. Other channel: Facebook group: Paw It Forward Pet Pantry
section: PET FOOD PANTRY (Valley Stream, Nassau County)
